_doc: Cave generator settings (ADR-0056, docs/CAVES_PLAN.md). Passed whole to CavePlan.build / CaveSites (the planner never reads Content itself); CavePlan.DEFAULTS mirrors this file. Metres and degrees; [min, max] ranges are picked by the cave's seed. Changing a shape number changes every cave: bump CavePlan.GEN_VERSION with it.
_outside: The spine starts this far down the slope from the mouth, so the tube breaks through the surface by itself.
_pitch: Into the hill (negative = down). A plan short of cover deepens its pitch 2 degrees at a time to pitch_limit_deg, then shortens.
_apron: Vegetation keep-out reaches this far down the slope from the spine's start.
_daylight_falloff: Probe daylight_ratio = exp(-depth from the mouth / this).

warp._doc: Seeded 3D lattice warping the walls (cell in metres, amplitude in metres of wall offset); precomputed per plan, faded out over the first 3 m past the mouth.

styles._doc: floor_drop: the floor sits this share of the radius under the spine (flat-floor cut). portal: share of the tunnel (at least portal_min m) past the mouth where the hood may be thinner than min_cover; the back wall is always checked. min_slope_deg: a steeper face for this style. chamber: end-chamber diameter range ([] = none). pocket_chance: odds of a side pocket.
